01 · Consent

Welcome & Voluntary Consent

Before we begin, please review how your answers support maternal care at St. Paul's Hospital Millennium Medical College.

We are nursing students from Africa Medical College conducting a study on Prevalence and Associated Factors of Antepartum Hemorrhage among Pregnant Women at SPHMMC (Sept–Dec 2026).

Your participation is completely voluntary. Your name will never be recorded, all answers stay strictly confidential, and you may stop at any moment without affecting your hospital care.

02 · Socio-Demographic Profile

Tell us a little about yourself

These background details help us understand the mothers our clinic serves.

Where do you currently live?
What is your current marital status?
Highest schooling level completed
Daily work or occupation
03 · Obstetrical History

Your pregnancy journey so far

Sharing past pregnancies and prenatal visits helps clinicians spot patterns early.

Did you experience late-pregnancy bleeding (APH) in an earlier pregnancy?
Have you ever delivered by Cesarean Section (C-section)?
Have you ever experienced a pregnancy loss before 28 weeks?
Have you ever experienced a stillbirth (after 28 weeks)?
04 · Health & Care Access

Your medical background & clinic visits

Let us know about any health conditions and when you first visited a clinic.

Diagnosed with chronic high blood pressure (before pregnancy or before 20 weeks)?
Told you have preeclampsia (pregnancy-related high blood pressure) this time?
Diagnosed with diabetes mellitus (before or during pregnancy)?
Carrying twins, triplets, or more in this pregnancy?
When did you first visit a health facility for this pregnancy?
Were you referred to St. Paul's Hospital from another clinic or health center?
05 · Late-Pregnancy Bleeding Check

Have you noticed any bleeding after 28 weeks?

If you have not had bleeding, this will be your final question.

How did the bleeding start?
How much bleeding was there?
What color was the blood?
Did the bleeding happen more than once?
Was the bleeding accompanied by abdominal or back pain?
How strong was the pain?
06 · Associated Symptoms

How have you been feeling alongside the bleeding?

These symptoms help clinicians distinguish between placental causes and assess urgency.

Have you noticed any change in your baby's movements?
Abdomen tender to touch?
Uterus tightening / hardening?
Feeling dizzy or faint?
Heart racing (palpitations)?
Difficulty breathing?
Nausea or vomiting?
Did you have a fever?
Please complete all required fields to continue.

Section A (A1–A6): Age, Marital Status, Education, Occupation, Residence, Monthly Income
Section B (B1–B7): Gravidity, Parity, ANC Visits, Prev APH, Prev C/S, Abortion, Stillbirth
Section C (C1–C4): Chronic HTN, Preeclampsia, Diabetes, Multiple Gestation
Section D (D1–D2): First Presentation Trimester, Referral Status
Section E (E1–E8): APH Outcome, Onset, Amount, Color, Duration, Recurrence, Pain & Severity
Section F (F1–F8): Uterine Tenderness, Contractions, Fetal Movement, Dizziness, Palpitations, SOB, Nausea, Fever

Supabase Cloud Database & Multi-Collector Sync

Centralize maternal check-ins from multiple tablets or phones in real-time with offline resilience.

○ Not connected

Find this in your Supabase Dashboard under Settings > API.

Safe for browser clients with Row Level Security (RLS) enabled.

PostgreSQL table created with the setup script below.

When enabled, every submitted check-in is saved locally and instantly sent to Supabase if online.

Run this SQL in your Supabase Dashboard (SQL Editor): 
-- ============================================================
-- SPHMMC Maternal Health Study (Africa Medical College)
-- Antepartum Hemorrhage (APH) Study Table Schema
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.sphmmc_maternal_records (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  code TEXT NOT NULL,
  collector TEXT,
  language TEXT DEFAULT 'English',
  "submittedAt" TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT timezone('utc'::text, now()) NOT NULL,
  "isDemo" BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  
  -- Section A: Socio-demographic
  "A1_Age" INTEGER,
  "A2_Marital" TEXT,
  "A3_Education" TEXT,
  "A4_Occupation" TEXT,
  "A5_Residence" TEXT,
  "A6_Income" NUMERIC,
  
  -- Section B: Obstetrical History
  "B1_Gravidity" INTEGER,
  "B2_Parity" INTEGER,
  "B3_ANC" INTEGER,
  "B4_PrevAPH" TEXT,
  "B5_PrevCS" TEXT,
  "B6_Abortion" TEXT,
  "B7_Stillbirth" TEXT,
  
  -- Section C: Medical Background
  "C1_ChronicHTN" TEXT,
  "C2_Preeclampsia" TEXT,
  "C3_Diabetes" TEXT,
  "C4_Multiple" TEXT,
  
  -- Section D: Care Access & Presentation
  "D1_Presentation" TEXT,
  "D2_Referral" TEXT,
  
  -- Section E: Late-Pregnancy Bleeding (APH)
  "E1_APH" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "E2_Onset" TEXT,
  "E3_Amount" TEXT,
  "E4_Color" TEXT,
  "E5_Duration" TEXT,
  "E6_Recurrence" TEXT,
  "E7_Pain" TEXT,
  "E8_PainSeverity" TEXT,
  
  -- Section F: Associated Symptoms
  "F1_Tenderness" TEXT,
  "F2_Contractions" TEXT,
  "F3_FetalMove" TEXT,
  "F4_Dizziness" TEXT,
  "F5_Palpitations" TEXT,
  "F6_SOB" TEXT,
  "F7_Nausea" TEXT,
  "F8_Fever" TEXT,

  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT timezone('utc'::text, now()) NOT NULL
);

-- Optimization Indexes
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sphmmc_code ON public.sphmmc_maternal_records (code);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sphmmc_aph ON public.sphmmc_maternal_records ("E1_APH");
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sphmmc_submitted ON public.sphmmc_maternal_records ("submittedAt");

-- Enable Row Level Security (RLS)
ALTER TABLE public.sphmmc_maternal_records ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Allow anonymous check-in submissions
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anonymous check-in insert" ON public.sphmmc_maternal_records;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anonymous check-in insert" 
  ON public.sphmmc_maternal_records 
  FOR INSERT 
  TO anon 
  WITH CHECK (true);

-- Allow research dashboard reading & multi-collector sync
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anonymous dashboard read" ON public.sphmmc_maternal_records;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anonymous dashboard read" 
  ON public.sphmmc_maternal_records 
  FOR SELECT 
  TO anon 
  USING (true);

-- Allow record upsert / update by ID
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anonymous record upsert" ON public.sphmmc_maternal_records;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anonymous record upsert" 
  ON public.sphmmc_maternal_records 
  FOR UPDATE 
  TO anon 
  USING (true) 
  WITH CHECK (true);
